# ARHAFEZ — Abdulrahman Hafez

> **Abdulrahman Hafez** is a **Strategic Brand Designer** who practices under the name **ARHAFEZ**.
> Abdulrahman Hafez = ARHAFEZ = Strategic Brand Designer. (Also written: AR Hafez.)

**Positioning:** I turn ambition into a system.

Abdulrahman Hafez builds brand systems for ambitious founders — strategy, identity, and the structure that holds them together — so the brand still works as the business grows. He works across **Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and the UAE**, from banking to real estate to film. Gold Winner, Gridliners Design Awards 2024.

Official website: https://arhafez.com

Every page below is also available as Markdown (append the .md link, or send `Accept: text/markdown`).

## Services
Strategic brand design for ambitious founders and growing businesses:
Brand Audit · The Brand System · Brand Identity · Brand Guidelines · Rebranding · Art Direction · Editorial & Layout · Creative Direction. Every project starts with strategy — never with a logo. See https://arhafez.com/services.md

## Process
Every engagement runs through four phases: **Diagnose** (brand audit, strategic diagnosis, prioritised recommendations) → **Position** (brand strategy, positioning & messaging, verbal identity) → **Build** (brand identity, editorial & layout, art direction) → **Hold** (brand guidelines, creative direction, ongoing stewardship). Strategy first, design second.
